<a id="music_instrument_ptrs"></a>
### [`music_instrument_ptrs`](../../../../src/music/music_tables.asm#L28) `$0F86-$0FB7`

*data*

Addresses of the 25 instrument records. Record: waveform; for pulse 5 bytes (width lo/hi, LFO flag, shift, LFO speed); AD, SR, slide step, octave offset, filter flag. Record, filter part (flag nonzero): mode, resonance, cutoff lo/hi, sweep slot ($80 none), sweep shift, sweep direction.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A06`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L47) (+14), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A0C`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L49) (+15), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A12`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L51) (+24), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A1B`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L54) (+25), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A2C`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L59) (+34), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A32`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L61) (+35), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A38`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L63) (+44), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A3E`](../../../../src/music/music_driver.asm#L65) (+45)

*data*
